# At the beach

This pack gathers beach words in German, from the sand and the sea to the towel and the ice cream.

A day at the sea needs few words, and most of them are nouns learned with their article. The list below runs from the place to the things people carry there. Each word comes with its translation beneath it, and the notes give the plural or a point about its use.

## The words

| Word | Notes |
|---|---|
| {stack}`der Strand \| beach` | Plural *die Strände*. |
| {stack}`das Meer \| sea` | Plural *die Meere*. |
| {stack}`die Sonne \| sun` | Rarely plural. |
| {stack}`der Sand \| sand` | No plural. |
| {stack}`das Wasser \| water` | No plural in everyday use. |
| {stack}`der Urlaub \| holiday` | Plural *die Urlaube*. |
| {stack}`das Eis \| ice cream` | Also means ice. |
| {stack}`der Hut \| hat` | Plural *die Hüte*. |
| {stack}`das Handtuch \| towel` | Plural *die Handtücher*. |
| {stack}`schwimmen \| to swim` | A verb. |

## Words that look alike

*Das Meer* is the sea, and *der See* is a lake.

## Hear it in practice

:::{audio-examples}
:track: a1/vocabulary/at-the-beach-1
:title: Am Strand 1
:title-en: At the beach 1

Der Strand ist heute voll.
: The beach is crowded today.

Das Meer ist blau.
: The sea is blue.

Die Sonne scheint.
: The sun is shining.

Der Sand ist warm.
: The sand is warm.

Das Wasser ist kalt.
: The water is cold.

Der Urlaub beginnt morgen.
: The holiday starts tomorrow.

Das Eis schmeckt gut.
: The ice cream tastes good.

Der Hut ist neu.
: The hat is new.

Das Handtuch liegt im Sand.
: The towel is lying in the sand.

Wir schwimmen im Meer.
: We are swimming in the sea.

Ich liege in der Sonne.
: I am lying in the sun.

Wir essen ein Eis.
: We are eating an ice cream.
:::

## Summary

The beach words are mostly nouns, learned with their article.
